title: Unitary Yang--Baxter Operators: Towards a Classification
summary: There is a well-known circle of conjectures relating unitary solutions of the Yang--Baxter equation, unitary braided fusion categories, topological quantum computation, and link invariants. Progress is limited by the lack of a classification of unitary Yang--Baxter operators. We propose a conjectural classification with three generating sources: monomial solutions, group-type solutions arising from Yetter--Drinfeld modules, and solutions from twisted group-algebra towers.
